name: Project Gutenberg Greek
access_path: Language catalogue → ebook bibliographic/credit records; bounded front-matter ranges inspected for source-scan citations. No full ebooks or scan books downloaded.
machine_path_definition: Fresh individual raster retrieved and decoded. For aligned text, additionally inspect the text/edition witness. Metadata/table/old-image success is separate.
date_range: Greek-language ebook catalogue enumerated; ebook release years are not printed-edition years.
target_classes: Polytonic prose/fiction; candidate aligned reference only with an exact scan edition

lines_per_page.limitation: All-segment detector counts are not target-class, admitted, codec-surviving or production yields. Target estimates are limited to the explicitly reviewed numbered pages; all other target yields are unknown.

overlap.summary: No certified edition clearance; missing manifests/author/publisher prevent an all-clear

rights.scan_rights: Per-scan rights are separate and usually not established by the ebook catalogue.
rights.text_rights: Catalogue says public domain in the USA; the PG licence and the user jurisdiction require separate review.
rights.cloud_ocr_processing: Not explicitly authorised by the retrieved wording; owner assessment required. No cloud processing performed.
rights.retention_terms: Not established beyond the linked source wording; no research retention entitlement inferred.
rights.training_use: No training permission determined by this inventory.
rights.redistribution_terms: Source licence/statement and item restrictions recorded above; no redistribution decision made.

owner_decisions.question: Which item rights/licence, lawful-access and retention/processor conditions permit the intended copies? If relying on Art. 21A/21B, the owner must decide applicability; this inventory does not.

blocker: Distributed proofreading is not automatically a literal transcription. Source scans and original printed editions are absent or incomplete in many credits. A sampled front matter explicitly reports polytonic-to-monotonic conversion and guessed missing words; headers may omit a later scan citation.
workaround: Use only explicit source-scan/edition bindings; record DP transformations of punctuation, hyphens, headers and spacing; compare the exact printed witness.

aligned_proofread.same_edition_scans: per ebook; bounded citation census, not a guarantee
aligned_proofread.scan_where: See gutenberg-citation-census.json for locators and unresolved editions
aligned_proofread.quality: DP credit and metadata are evidence of preparation, not literal same-edition line truth
